headline: Magic Cylinder
title: Magic Cylinder Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Magic Cylinder. What is it? It is a Normal Trap Card. What does it do? When your opponent's monster declares an attack, negate the attack and deal damage to your opponent equal to that monster's attack. How do you use it? Best against one huge attacker. A four thousand attack monster deals four thousand to its own owner. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
